notes: Chunk 28 holds six Purdue Krannert 'Distinguished PhD Alum' profile pages, each with exactly one Common Crawl capture (CC-MAIN-2013-20; file timestamps 2013-05-26 to 2013-06-20) and no live copy. Every snapshot was readable; each page is a single-person record naming the alumnus plus a 2013-era current title and institution, so one row per page was written (six rows). None of the pages states a graduation year, a Purdue department/program, a dissertation, an advisor or a first job, so listedYear is null, yearMeaning 'unstated', program null, and destination/position hold the CURRENT (2013) affiliation shown on the page, not a first placement; the integrator should not treat these destinations as initial placements. 'degree' is recorded as 'PhD' because the page heading is 'Distinguished PhD Alum'. These are distinguished-alumni honorees, several of them in accounting, finance, marketing, economics, MIS and HR rather than operations, and the alumni pages are from Krannert generally, so population relevance must be judged by the integrator. Caveats: the Sonnenschein page spells the name 'Hugo Sonnenchein' (URL says sonnenschein); the Hughes page spells the chair 'Earnst and Young' (kept as written). The sidebar 'Graduate profiles 2013/2012' lists (Brendan Bonner ... Byron Young) are navigation links to general Krannert alumni-magazine graduate profiles, not identified as doctoral graduates, so they were not recorded. The chunk's url field and the Common Crawl 'page' address differ only by the www. prefix / path casing; the index lookup URL from each file footer was used as sourceUrl.
